title: GQUIC: add support for Q046
description:
Even if Q046 is an old version, it is still used by the current QUICHE implementation.

In this way, the latest Wireshark is able to dissect all GQUIC versions supported by recent Chrome (Q043,46,50 and T050,51), i.e. all GQUIC versions that you can find in live traffic right now.

Pcap examples are available in #15984 and in the attachment: [quic_q46.pcap](/uploads/bdfa09f9eab081c4310a18b5e82f3f9a/quic_q46.pcap)

Some Q046 information are available in:
https://docs.google.com/document/d/1FcpCJGTDEMblAs-Bm5TYuqhHyUqeWpqrItw2vkMFsdY/edit#heading=h.32qkkficm7za

Close #15984
